item.title: World Cup 2026: Spain v Argentina countdown, Trump to attend final, England news – live
item.description:
The Road to Glory: Spain and Argentina Set to Clash in World Cup 2026 Final

Sunday’s highly anticipated World Cup 2026 final between Spain and Argentina is fast approaching, with the anticipation building for a thrilling encounter between two of the world’s top football nations. The stage is set for a spectacular conclusion to the tournament, and the stakes are high as both teams vie for the coveted trophy.

Donald Trump, in a surprise move, has announced that he will attend the final, with White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt confirming the news on Thursday. Leavitt expressed the White House’s enthusiasm for the match, stating, “We look forward to the final match on Sunday, and I know the president looks forward to attending. This is a fitting conclusion to a tournament that showcased America’s ability to host the world on the grandest stage.”
